cohort: This abstract discusses pregnant patients diagnosed with various genotypes of sickle cell disease (Hb S/C, S/b(+)-thalassaemia, S/S, S/b(0)-thalassaemia).
finding: Pregnancy significantly elevates the risk of maternal vaso-occlusive crises, infections, and preeclampsia, as well as fetal complications like preterm delivery and intrauterine growth restriction, for patients with sickle cell disease.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is not systematically recommended, despite being more frequent due to obstetrical and maternal complications, unless there are maternal contraindications.
